limitations.text: The engine compares periods in observational data: a change it reports is an association with the period, not a finding about its cause.
the series stepped in 2025-03, and the months since are too few to fit and replay a forecast on alone (that needs 45), so the models learned across the step

the 131 replayed forecasts that were made before a step and scored after it measure the step, not the method, so they are left out of the ranges and the replay scores, and the same-month-last-year rule is scaled by the step (+87.4% at 2025-03; +30.2% at 2024-07) for months whose last-year value is from before it
months ahead shown: 9 of 12; after a step the forecast could not fit around, a month ahead is shown only while its 80% range's high end is at most 2 times its low end

The average amount is not compared: rows where category is 'RENT' and the other rows hold different kinds of amount, so an average across them means nothing; each kind's monthly total is compared instead.

Not measured in this release: tipping points for the set-aside rows, which segments drive a change and reversals within them, and model-based probabilities. Power is measured only at one size of true change (20%) in simulated conditions: each tested claim quotes the nearest one, not a power computed for itself.

The release check certifies each simulated no-change condition below a 2.0% false-confirm cap; 50 of 52 conditions pass and 2 do not, so in those conditions the engine can confirm a change that is not there more often than that.
Accuracy, whether the values match reality, is not measured: no rows were checked against their source.

analyst_insights: Key numbers: 1.22 million (Amount, the 12 months to 2026-08; +32.2% against the 12 months to 2025-08); 101,887 (Amount, 2026-08; +1.6% on 2025-08); 107,599 (Record high, 2026-03; low 36,205 in 2023-11); 78.7% (of the change came from East York Low-Rise; +233,150, by Property).
The total of Amount rose from 918,969 in the 12 months to 2025-08 to 1.22 million in the 12 months to 2026-08 (+32.2%).
In 2026-08, Amount rose to 101,887 from 100,314 in 2025-08 (+1.6% year on year); the three months from 2026-06 moved the same way (+3.6% on a year earlier).
Over 56 months (2022-01 to 2026-08) Amount moved by +1,457 a month on a straight line (95% range +1,230 to +1,684). Its monthly record high was 107,599 in 2026-03 and its low 36,205 in 2023-11.

By Property, East York Low-Rise carried 78.7% of the change (+233,150); the top three of 5 groups carried 90.8%. East York Low-Rise first appears in 2025-03, so much of that is a group added, not growth of what was already there.
Among rows where Property is East York Low-Rise, RENT (Category) carried 90.8% of its change (+211,611).

In the 12 months to 2026-08, East York Low-Rise holds 38.0% of the total Amount, then Parkdale Walk-Up (24.7%), and the top three of 5 Property groups 77.6% (Herfindahl-Hirschman index 2,527, the same as 3.96 equal-sized groups: not concentrated); the top three held 74.0% in the 12 months to 2025-08 (+3.60 percentage points, more concentrated). Across all 3,285 rows, Parkdale Walk-Up appears…
Unit 3 is the most common Unit (311 of 3,285 rows, 9.5%); RENT the most common Category (45.3%), then APPLIANCE (8.5%).
Over 56 months (2022-01 to 2026-08) the month of the year accounts for 0.0% of the movement in Amount around its trend once chance is allowed for: no season to speak of.
Leaving out East York Low-Rise, Amount still rose (+9.1%).
